query:
SELECT 
  'cashClosings' as tabla,
  COUNT(*) as registros,
  SUM(CAST(zReading AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_ingresos
FROM cashClosings
WHERE DATE(date) >= '2025-12-01' AND DATE(date) <= '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'invoices' as tabla,
  COUNT(*) as registros,
  SUM(CAST(totalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_ingresos
FROM invoices
WHERE DATE(invoiceDate) >= '2025-12-01' AND DATE(invoiceDate) <= '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'otros_gastos' as tabla,
  COUNT(*) as registros,
  SUM(CAST(importe AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_ingresos
FROM otros_gastos
WHERE DATE(fecha) >= '2025-12-01' AND DATE(fecha) <= '2025-12-31';
